text":"太奶","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":15,"text":"太奶","occurrence":1,"name":true}]},{"id":"OriginalOwner","mentions":[{"paragraph":40,"text":"原来的主人","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"Creator","mentions":[{"paragraph":66,"text":"造物主","occurrence":0,"name":true}]}],"disclosures":[{"id":"d1","from":2,"to":2,"text":"本书出场角色均已满18岁，不存在任何未成年人。","channel":"author","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d2","from":4,"to":4,"text":"有声音要求苏天晴报出姓名。","channel":"voice","mode":"request","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d3","from":5,"to":5,"text":"苏天晴说出自己的名字。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d4","from":6,"to":6,"text":"昏暗房间里传出清脆悦耳的女声，以及一道仿佛来自遥远彼方的低沉言语。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d5","from":7,"to":7,"text":"苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，并从落地镜中瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d6","from":8,"to":8,"text":"镜中身影有灿烂金色长发、头顶毛茸茸耳朵，刘海下五官精致。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["FoxBody"]},{"id":"d7","from":10,"to":10,"text":"镜中身影是一只娇小的金毛狐女。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["FoxBody"]},{"id":"d8","from":12,"to":12,"text":"古书以低沉言语表示知道了。","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d9","from":13,"to":13,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回黑色古书。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryCodex","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d10","from":15,"to":15,"text":"五分钟前，刚结束连续三个夜班的苏天晴在街边面摊吃牛肉面时听到太奶在背后说话，回头看见太奶坐在藤椅上编围巾，随后胸口一疼、眼前一黑，背过气去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","GreatGrandma"]},{"id":"d11","from":16,"to":16,"text":"苏天晴伸手在自己身侧的大尾巴上用力薅了一把。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d12","from":17,"to":17,"text":"尾巴传来柔顺触感，同时一股陌生的摩挲拉拽感从尾巴尖直冲天灵盖，使耳朵竖起、整只狐绷直身体。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d13","from":18,"to":18,"text":"苏天晴觉得触感好真实。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["FoxBody"]},{"id":"d14","from":19,"to":19,"text":"古书问苏天晴在干什么。","channel":"voice","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d15","from":20,"to":20,"text":"黑色古书不太明白眼前这只狐狐为什么要突然用怪异手法薅她自己的尾巴。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryCodex","SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d16","from":21,"to":21,"text":"古书心想这样不疼吗。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d17","from":22,"to":22,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声，让古书稍等一下。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d18","from":23,"to":23,"text":"苏天晴掩饰尴尬、阻止古书继续说话，并飞快理清思绪。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d19","from":24,"to":24,"text":"苏天晴认为自己重生了。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d20","from":25,"to":25,"text":"苏天晴认为自己重生成了金毛狐女。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d21","from":26,"to":26,"text":"苏天晴疑惑眼前这本黑色会说话的书是什么，并希望能有人解释。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryCodex","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d22","from":27,"to":27,"text":"苏天晴问古书是谁。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d23","from":28,"to":28,"text":"古书沉默思考这只呆头呆脑的狐狐是否是自己要找的人，随后重复开场白。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryCodex","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d24","from":29,"to":29,"text":"古书自称墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找最优秀的适格者。","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d25","from":30,"to":30,"text":"古书称那个人就是苏天晴。","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d26","from":31,"to":31,"text":"苏天晴听完后陷入沉默与思索。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d27","from":32,"to":32,"text":"苏天晴从床上蹦下，走到落地镜前，沉默看向镜中穿宽松睡裙的娇小身影。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d28","from":33,"to":33,"text":"苏天晴抬起一只脚，欣赏白皙软嫩带红晕的小脚。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d29","from":34,"to":34,"text":"苏天晴认为脚完美、绝品。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["FoxBody"]},{"id":"d30","from":35,"to":35,"text":"古书说看来苏天晴对现在的身体很满意。","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d31","from":37,"to":37,"text":"古书问苏天晴为什么盯着脚看，正常情况下不应该是这样。","channel":"voice","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d32","from":38,"to":38,"text":"苏天晴说小脚才是世界上最美好的瑰宝，吃饭时看见都能多炫两碗。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["FoxBody"]},{"id":"d33","from":39,"to":39,"text":"苏天晴嘴上回答古书，脑中对现状有了大致了解。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d34","from":40,"to":40,"text":"苏天晴意识到这本书知道自己并不是这副身体原来的主人。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryCodex","OriginalOwner","SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d35","from":41,"to":41,"text":"古书说既然苏天晴满意，就可以直接快进到下个步骤。","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d36","from":43,"to":43,"text":"古书让苏天晴听着。","channel":"voice","mode":"request","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d37","from":44,"to":44,"text":"古书称苏天晴是墨丘利秘典的最佳适格者，作为星界使者会引导她走上完美生活，而她只需与古书签订一个小小契约。","channel":"voice","mode":"promise","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d38","from":45,"to":45,"text":"苏天晴立刻答应签约。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d39","from":46,"to":46,"text":"古书对苏天晴立刻答应感到意外。","channel":"voice","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d40","from":48,"to":48,"text":"古书说苏天晴不按套路出牌，契约不该说签就签，都不犹豫考虑。","channel":"voice","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d41","from":49,"to":49,"text":"苏天晴说古书思想狭隘，并称其为小破书。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d42","from":50,"to":50,"text":"苏天晴问古书世界上最通用的愿望是哪两个。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d43","from":51,"to":51,"text":"古书反问是哪两个。","channel":"voice","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d44","from":53,"to":53,"text":"苏天晴说取之不尽的财富以及变成萝莉是世界上最通用的两个愿望。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d45","from":55,"to":55,"text":"苏天晴说变成萝莉本身就是最大的奖励，更何况还是这样一只可爱的狐狐。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"d46","from":57,"to":57,"text":"古书觉得好像有哪里很对又根本不对，但迅速把话题拖回正题。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d47","from":58,"to":58,"text":"古书问既然苏天晴答应，两者之间的契约就算成立。","channel":"voice","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d48","from":59,"to":59,"text":"苏天晴不假思索地说成立。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d49","from":61,"to":61,"text":"苏天晴问能否询问契约的具体内容。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d50","from":62,"to":62,"text":"苏天晴担心契约是奇怪的奴隶契约，那样就亏大了。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d51","from":63,"to":63,"text":"古书说契约内容是反派魔法少女。","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d52","from":66,"to":66,"text":"古书说契约已签订，从今天开始苏天晴将成为魔法少女活跃于世，造物主为她量身定制了一整套任务，能帮助她逐步走上反派魔法少女的顶点。","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing","Creator"]},{"id":"d53","from":67,"to":67,"text":"苏天晴质问魔法少女是怎么回事，是不是死亡率高达90%的高危职业。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d54","from":68,"to":68,"text":"古书让苏天晴放心，说是王道系的那种。","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d55","from":69,"to":69,"text":"苏天晴说正因为是王道故事，当反派才是纯纯找死。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d56","from":70,"to":70,"text":"苏天晴突然有点后悔。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d57","from":71,"to":71,"text":"苏天晴想王道系是魔法少女们面对强敌逐渐成长，喊着友情和羁绊把反派干碎；即使反派有系统有任务也很难在王道系故事里把主角干碎。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d58","from":72,"to":72,"text":"苏天晴心想自己还有没有反悔机会，能否被送回原来的身体，觉得急性心肌梗死还有抢救机会。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d59","from":73,"to":73,"text":"墨丘利秘典绑定成功。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["MercuryCodex","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d60","from":74,"to":74,"text":"脑子里响起的声音让苏天晴欲哭无泪。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d61","from":75,"to":75,"text":"契约成立。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"d62","from":76,"to":76,"text":"古书让苏天晴走上反派魔法少女的道路。","channel":"voice","mode":"request","holder":"MercuryCodex","about":["SuTianqing"]}],"beats":[{"id":"b1","from":1,"to":1,"gist":"章节标题：第1章 反派魔法少女。","mode":"paratext","about":[]},{"id":"b2","from":2,"to":2,"gist":"作者声明本书出场角色均已满18岁，不存在未成年人。","mode":"paratext","about":[]},{"id":"b3","from":3,"to":3,"gist":"分隔符。","mode":"paratext","about":[]},{"id":"b4","from":4,"to":5,"gist":"有声音要求报出姓名，苏天晴回答自己的名字。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"b5","from":6,"to":11,"gist":"昏暗房间中苏天晴面对飘浮的黑色古书，并从落地镜里看见陌生娇小的金毛狐女形貌。","mode":"description","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex","FoxBody"]},{"id":"b6","from":12,"to":14,"gist":"古书回应并再次出声，苏天晴仍感茫然。","mode":"narrative","about":["MercuryCodex","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"b7","from":15,"to":15,"gist":"回忆五分钟前苏天晴刚下夜班吃面，听到太奶说话后胸口疼、眼前黑，背过气去。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","GreatGrandma"]},{"id":"b8","from":16,"to":18,"gist":"苏天晴薅自己的大尾巴，感受到异常真实的触感与身体反应，惊叹真实。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","FoxBody"]},{"id":"b9","from":19,"to":23,"gist":"古书问她干什么，苏天晴干咳阻止并理清思绪。","mode":"narrative","about":["MercuryCodex","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"b10","from":24,"to":26,"gist":"苏天晴意识到自己重生成了金毛狐女，并疑惑会说话的黑书是什么。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex","FoxBody"]},{"id":"b11","from":27,"to":31,"gist":"苏天晴问古书是谁，古书重复自称墨丘利秘典并称她是最优秀适格者，苏天晴沉默思索。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"b12","from":32,"to":39,"gist":"苏天晴到镜前欣赏新身体和小脚，古书评论其满意身体却盯脚看，苏天晴以脚为珍宝作答，并意识到古书知道她不是原主人。","mode":"description","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex","FoxBody","OriginalOwner"]},{"id":"b13","from":40,"to":42,"gist":"苏天晴进一步怀疑古书知道她并非原身主人，古书提议进入下一步，将她唤回正题。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex","OriginalOwner"]},{"id":"b14","from":43,"to":48,"gist":"古书说明苏天晴是最佳适格者并让她签小契约，苏天晴立刻答应，古书因她不按套路而凌乱。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"b15","from":49,"to":57,"gist":"苏天晴以财富和变成萝莉为最通用愿望反驳古书，古书无语后把话题拉回正题。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"b16","from":58,"to":61,"gist":"古书确认契约成立，苏天晴答应后才问契约具体内容。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryCodex"]},{"id":"b17","from":62,"to":66,"gist":"苏天晴担心是奴隶契约，古书却宣布契约内
